intro: Allure is simplicity that stays striking. With geometric lines, soft cushioning, and solid wood strength—it feels as good as it looks.

features.title: We crafted it with lasting strength
features.text: Made from solid rubberwood, our chair provides a strong, stable frame that’s built to support you day after day.

features.title: Comfort that feels naturally refined
features.text: Fabric upholstery and PU foam cushioning come together to give you a soft, supportive seat through every meal.

features.title: A backrest shaped for your posture
features.text: The gently curved backrest offers ergonomic support—helping you sit taller, straighter, and more comfortably.

features.title: Finished to handle real life
features.text: A scratch-resistant PU coating keeps the surface protected from daily wear—so your chair stays beautiful for longer.

features.title: A design that speaks in clean lines
features.text: The contemporary grid pattern adds quiet sophistication—striking the perfect balance between statement and subtlety.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
